verdict.rationale: WezTerm's documented `wezterm cli` subcommand controls a running GUI or mux instance to spawn programs and manipulate tabs and panes. A runtime probe confirmed a fully headless agent loop: `spawn` returned a pane-id, `send-text` ran a command, `get-text` read the output back, and `list` enumerated windows, tabs and panes. A community user also independently cites `get-text` for dumping scrollback. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the individual subcommands (e.g. pane splitting and machine-readable output formats) beyond the summary-level docs snippet.
